groups.title: adisyon yaşam döngüsü, karaoke odası, iptal, taşıma, gün sonu
groups.hints: Main files: server/services/orders.ts (cancel, move/transfer items, merge, open table), server/services/rooms.ts (room timer), server/services/days.ts (closeDay), server/jobs.ts (autoDayEndTick), limited portions / sold-out (grep portion, soldOut, tukendi). A running room timer is a billable charge: it must never be silently lost by cancel, move-all, merge or day close, and must not start while a basket is pending on the fiscal device or on a site-paid online order (AGENTS.md rule 7). Another area (odeme-indirim) also edits server/services/orders.ts at the same time in its own worktree: keep your edits inside the functions you need, do not reformat or reorder unrelated code.

groups.title: ödeme, indirim, iptal onayı, bahşiş, kalem bazlı ödeme, girdi doğrulama
groups.hints: Main files: server/services/orders.ts (addPayment, refunds, discounts, voids, kitchen status changes), server/routes/pos.ts, shared/order-calc.ts, server/services/menu.ts (option maxQty), src/pages/order/PaymentModal.tsx and src/lib/api.ts if the client must send something new. You are the ONLY area allowed to change server/db/schema.ts and add a migration (needed for payment idempotency, state-07: e.g. a client-generated request id per payment attempt, unique per order, a replay returns the first result instead of recording twice); generate it with `npm run db:generate` (never hand-written SQL) and commit drizzle/ changes; tests/harness.ts runs migrations. For discount claims weigh the verifier votes: money-13 was refuted 2 of 3 (the stored amount behaves like a fixed amount off the bill), money-12 was 2 of 3 real. maxDiscountPct must cap the combined effect of line and order discounts. Another area (adisyon-oda) also edits server/services/orders.ts in its own worktree: keep edits inside the functions you need.

groups.title: yazarkasa (ÖKC) sepeti, sonuçlar, fiş iptali, birleşen adisyon
groups.hints: Main files: server/okc/service.ts (sendOrderToDevice, cancelDeviceBasket, applyResult, refreshReceipt, ensurePolling), server/okc/basket.ts (buildBasket: lineNet, service line, drift, KDV sections), server/okc/providers/*, and refundExternalPayments / addExternalPayments in server/services/orders.ts. The claims predate the provider refactor (applySale is now a wrapper over applyResult(FiscalResult)). Invariants: the device receipt total equals what LafPOS charges, the KDV per section on the device equals LafPOS's KDV split, a fiscal void never rewrites a closed business day (decide and document: e.g. refuse automatic refund into a closed day, record an alarm for the manager, and reflect it in the open day), payments recorded from a device never exceed what the device actually collected, nothing pending is forgotten after a restart. Update docs/04-YAZARKASA.md for behaviour changes. Never call real Token endpoints; tests use the simulator provider or stub fetch.

groups.title: raporlar, CSV dışa aktarım, tarih aralığı, iş günü
groups.hints: Main files: server/services/reports.ts, server/routes/reports.ts (CSV export), src/pages/reports/ReportsPage.tsx, src/pages/patron/PatronPage.tsx, src/lib/period.ts. The ciro definitions and invariants are in .claude/skills/validate-data/SKILL.md (Bu projede) and tests/report-reconciliation.test.ts: every change must keep that test green and any new report number must be added to it. CSV: neutralize formula injection (cells starting with = + - @ tab CR) and keep Turkish decimal commas consistently; quote fields so text with ; or newlines cannot split rows. Large ranges: SQLite has a limit on bound variables (inArray with tens of thousands of ids fails); bound the date range (e.g. max 400 days) with a clear 422 message; impossible dates must be a 422, not a 500. 'Bugün' must mean the current business day (05:00 rule in shared/time.ts, or the open day if it is still open past 05:00), not the browser's calendar date. Hourly charts should order the business day from its 05:00 start so after-midnight sales come last. The lafmaliyet sales list belongs to another area (senkron): do not edit server/sync/lafmaliyet.ts.

groups.title: laffogato ve lafmaliyet senkronu, LafPOS Uzaktan, ürün görselleri
groups.hints: Main files: server/sync/laffogato-orders.ts, server/sync/laffogato-menu.ts, server/sync/menu-sync.ts, server/sync/lafmaliyet.ts (day push and the sales list: lines must sum to the Z total including service; M and L must stay separate), server/sync/cloud.ts, api/uzaktan.ts, server/services/media.ts, server/services/days.ts (cashIn), server/routes/admin.ts (portion refill). The contract with the other systems is docs/03-ENTEGRASYON.md (a field that is not there does not travel). The real counterpart code is in sibling clones: read it with `git -C /Users/okanberkmanavoglu/Downloads/laffogato fetch -q origin && git -C /Users/okanberkmanavoglu/Downloads/laffogato show origin/main:<path>` (same for lafmaliyet); NEVER checkout, edit or commit in those repos (other sessions use them). Rule 6: no automatic request to laffogato's signed endpoints more often than every 5 minutes; a failed pull must still be retried within that budget. Never mark paid online orders closed because of a malformed or unexpected response.

groups.title: PIN onayı, oturum, yetki sızıntısı, girdi doğrulama
groups.hints: Main files: server/lib/auth.ts (approver PIN check: throttle and lock out per user and per source after repeated failures, write an alarm to the audit log, keep the error message identical for wrong PIN and locked so it is not an oracle), server/routes/events.ts (SSE: drop the stream when the session ends, the user is deactivated or loses the permission; re-check periodically and on logout/role change), server/routes/cash.ts (per-staff sales amounts need rapor.maliyet), server/routes/admin.ts (PIN uniqueness check must not reveal other users' PINs: generic message and throttling), empty PATCH bodies (422 instead of 500; patchOf is in server/lib/http.ts), impossible dates and times (reservations, happy hours, scheduledFor) rejected with 422. The client must keep working: check src/ for the error codes and flows you touch.

groups.title: kasa arayüzü hesap tahminleri, müşteri ekranı, kasa sayımı
groups.hints: Main files: src/lib/cart.ts and src/lib/boot.ts (client price estimates must apply the active happy hour exactly like the server: reuse the shared calculation instead of duplicating it), src/lib/display.ts and src/pages/CustomerDisplayPage.tsx (order discount must not be subtracted twice), src/pages/cash/CashCount.tsx (card tips must not show as a slip difference; check how the server computes expected card totals), src/pages/order/PaymentModal.tsx 'Kalem seç' rows (show the remaining amount for the remaining quantity). Prefer pure helpers in shared/ or src/lib with unit tests (vitest) over UI-only fixes. Another area (odeme-indirim) may also touch PaymentModal.tsx: keep edits local.
